Take a journey through our exclusive example Liferay SaaS solution to see how easy it is to use
Liferay’s low-code and no-code capabilities to build exactly what you need for your business.
What to Expect and How it Works

• Quick start
    With this trial, there’s no manual setup: You’ll receive your cloud-based Self-Guided Trial within 10 minutes.
  • Role test drive
    Walk through the day-to-day experiences of different user roles, including a Customer, a Customer Support Representative, and an Administrator.
  • Hands-on testing
    Explore Liferay capabilities like Low-Code, Sites, CMS, and Security.
  • Functionality deep dive
    Learn about functionality like Objects, Client Extensions, Fragments, and Segmentation.
  • Apply & understand
    Perform exercises that will strengthen your command of the platform’s capabilities.
    • Create tickets and move them through workflows.
    • Work with Objects and default Liferay Frameworks.
    • Use Objects through Client Extensions to implement advanced requirements.
    • Configure the look and feel of the solution.
    • Understand web content structures.
  • Open playground
    Dive deeper into solutions of your choosing with unlimited access to Liferay DXP’s capabilities.

Liferay helps organizations meet their unique challenges by creating innovative, customer-centered experiences on our cloud-powered digital experience platform (DXP). Our platform is open source, which makes it more reliable and secure. Over a thousand organizations in financial services, insurance, manufacturing, healthcare and government use Liferay worldwide.

Our goal is to help companies reach their full potential to serve others, and we try to leave a positive mark on the world through our business and technology.
